integrationRule: Reviewers commit per atomic group and push as they go. The captain polls the three review branches, imports dispositions by owned path as each atomic group lands (never waiting for a full lane), records accepted closures in data/rcap-all50/review-artifacts/f2-dispositions.json, and regenerates the shared ledger exactly once per integration window. Only technical_approved closures promote candidates; independence holds — no reviewer edits lane-owned artifacts, and review of the implementing lane's own bytes by that lane counts for nothing.
